strategy.name: London Breakout & Asian Range Breakout
strategy.summary: Mark the Asian box (00:00–06:00 UTC), then trade a confirmed break-and-retest or a 'Judas swing' after the London open.

sessions.name: Asian box
sessions.dstNote: 05:00–11:00 Pakistan time all year (UTC has no DST)

sessions.name: London open (assumed)
sessions.dstNote: 12:00–14:00 PKT in summer, 13:00–15:00 PKT in winter

rules.text: Asian box 00:00–06:00 UTC. EURUSD/GBPUSD box 15–45 pips; Gold $8–$22. Skip if Asia already moved ~80 pips.
rules.checklistQuestion: Was the Asian box inside the allowed size?

rules.text: Enter only in the London window after the open.
rules.checklistQuestion: Did you enter inside the London window?

rules.text: Method 1: a 15m candle closes above the Asian high, then price retests the high → buy on the retest. Short: mirror.
rules.checklistQuestion: Did you wait for a 15m close and a retest?

rules.text: Method 2 (Judas): with a bullish 4H trend, price wicks below the Asian low in the first 30 min, then a strong 15m bullish candle closes back inside → buy.
rules.checklistQuestion: Was there a sweep of the Asian low and a strong close back inside?

rules.text: Trade only in line with the 4H EMA 50. No blind pending stop orders.
rules.checklistQuestion: Was the trade in the direction of the 4H EMA 50?

rules.text: Method 1: stop below the box midpoint. Method 2: 5 pips beyond the sweep wick.
rules.checklistQuestion: Was the stop at the box midpoint / beyond the sweep?

rules.text: Targets 1.5 × and 2.5 × box height, or exit before the New York open.
rules.checklistQuestion: Did you exit before the New York open?
